title: Understanding the Contoso Demo Data Tool in Business Central
summary: The Contoso Demo Data Tool is a new, extensible coded approach that replaced RapidStart Configuration Packages for creating demo-ready companies in Business Central, starting with 2024 Wave 2 Update 3. It supports multiple modules across finance, manufacturing, warehouse, and other business functions, and can be triggered manually or during company creation.
key_points: Microsoft transitioned from RapidStart Configuration Packages to the Contoso Demo Data Tool, beginning with 2024 Wave 2 Update 3

The tool supports modular initialization covering Common, Foundation, Finance, Manufacturing, Warehouse, Inventory, Sales, Purchasing, Service, Human Resources, Fixed Assets, Jobs, CRM, E-Documents, Sustainability, Subscription Billing, and Statistical Accounts
Users can run the tool manually in an empty company or automatically during new company creation, with options for Setup Data or Complete Demo Data
The tool is still under active development with known issues around data dependencies and re-running scenarios between different initialization modes

quotes.text: The tool is not fully data-agnostic. Errors can occur if you initialize some modules and then try others later without the prerequisites.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical limitation users must understand to avoid initialization failures

quotes.text: It's clear that Microsoft is investing heavily in this tool. I believe ISVs should consider adopting the same approach in their own solutions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Strategic recommendation for partners to adopt coded demo data practices
